fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-09d03f6f at f65c3f54: go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(text-refs|describe-golden)' passes (text-refs-write.txtar, text-refs-engine-writes.txtar, describe-golden unchanged since lenient is unexported). make check passed fmt-check, vet and test, then self-check failed only on stale .rhiza/rendered files (no render before landing, as expected).
